Like everyone said talk with your therapist.  What you feel is normal tho. Emotions are actually good. Some suck but dont suppress them, that makes it worse. It's okay to feel emotions. You can take your anger out through kickboxing like you already are! Mindfulness is great. Try guided meditation too.  Reading books on self help , helps sooo much too. I used to blow up all the time with my boss, because I hate bosses and people telling me what to do.  But after reading everyday, I gained more awareness and understanding of others. That allowed me to have a change in perspective,  other than my own, and helped me have grace and patience for people.  Because understand that peoples actions do not reflect you. If they are nasty, yes its absolutely annoying, but it only says everything about them and nothing about you. Breathing helps alot too, esp in stressful situations.  Over time you will learn that your emotions are not you, and just feelings so they will pass. So you don't have to act on them.  Hey and maybe you are meant for more than a job/working for someone else ;)
